name: Perspective
description: Corrects the stretching of a wide field of view by redrawing the picture with another projection: 1 is the game's own, lower values pull the edges in, and the picture is zoomed in to hide the borders that opens up.

params.label: Field of view
params.doc: The field of view the game is drawing at, in degrees.

params.label: Field of view type
params.doc: Which direction the field of view is measured in.

params.label: Projection
params.doc: 1 is the game's own projection, 0.5 stereographic, 0 equidistant and -1 orthographic; lower pulls the edges in more.

params.label: Vertical amount
params.doc: How much of the correction applies up and down; 0 corrects sideways only.

params.label: Cropping
params.doc: 0 shows the whole corrected picture with borders, 1 zooms in until the borders are gone.

params.label: Mirror border
params.doc: Fills the border with a mirrored copy of the picture instead of a colour.

params.label: Border colour
params.doc: The colour and opacity of the border.

params.label: Border corner
params.doc: Rounds the corners of the picture.

params.label: Vignette
params.doc: Darkens the edges of the corrected picture.

params.label: Vignette offset
params.doc: Moves the start of the vignette; positive pushes it towards the edges.
